cause: Production had no custom credential and fell back to the lost legacy access key.
operation: Installed the chosen staging password hash in production with a new credential revision; plaintext password was neither retrieved nor requested.
passwordLoginNote: The user holds the plaintext password; verification checks record integrity and server readability without collecting it.
verificationMethod: A temporary 120-second recovery verifier bound to the installed credential revision was accepted by the production PHP API without resetting the password or opening a session. It was then deleted and rejected on reuse.
method: Authorized owner-runtime repair over the existing Panthur FTP connection. Normal deployments continue to exclude private credential files.
